output.subject: We've received your feedback about your mortgage statement
output.body:
Dear ⟦CUSTOMER_NAME_1⟧,

Thank you for taking the time to write to us about your mortgage statement. We have received your complaint, and we want you to know it has been read carefully.

You told us that the new statement format is very hard to read, and that you couldn't find your principal balance on it, so you had to call us just to find out what you owe. You mentioned that the previous statement was a single page and made sense to you. You've asked us to bring back the old format or, at the very least, to show the balance at the top of the statement.

We're sorry for the frustration this has caused, especially having to make a phone call to get information you expected to see at a glance.

Your complaint is now with a specialist team, who are reviewing it and will respond to you within 10 business days. If there is anything else you'd like them to consider in the meantime, please reply to this email and we'll make sure it's included.

Kind regards,

Customer Care, Meridian Harbor Bank
notes_for_analyst: Decide whether the reply should confirm where the principal balance appears on the new statement format.
Decide how to respond to the requests to restore the old one-page format or move the balance to the top.
Consider whether this feedback should be shared with the team responsible for statement design.
The customer had to call to learn their balance; check whether that call was recorded and what they were told.
Draft takes no position on the substance per acknowledge-only handling; add specifics only once reviewed.
